∫01Bnf(x) dx=1n+1∑k=0nf(k/n),∫01L∣x−c∣ dx=L2(c2+(1−c)2).\begin{aligned}
      &\int_0^1 B_nf(x)\,dx\\
      &=\frac1{n+1}\sum_{k=0}^n f(k/n),\\
      &\int_0^1 L|x-c|\,dx\\
